free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly suggests further investigation due to the rising PSA trend (from 3.0 to 7.4 ng/mL) and the presence of a PI-RADS 3 lesion in the right mid-gland peripheral zone. This finding, combined with the current PSA of 7.4 ng/mL, contradicts the lower-risk visual assessment of the DRE and the prior negative biopsy. The rapid PSA velocity of 0.97 ng/mL/yr and the PI-RADS 3 finding are the key factors driving this decision.
